note: One case per rule category (section 9.2). This file is the per-rule test-of-record: check_source must produce exactly the diagnostics a case expects over its source, no more and no fewer. Core conformance (section 9.1) covers the seven construction-time rules HC003, HC006, HC007, HC011, HC-SM01, HC-SM02, HC-SM05; the parse gate HC-SYN and the suppression guarantees hold at every level. HC-P003 is carried as the first structural-rule case. Full and the remaining levels are added as their rules are built (bead honest-framework-4gv).

cases.description: Source that does not parse gates every other rule and reports HC-SYN.
A chain() constructed with no links is an empty chain.

input.source:
from honest_type import chain
report = chain()

cases.description: A chain() with links is not empty and fires nothing.

input.source:
from honest_type import chain
report = chain(step_one, step_two)

cases.description: A chain imported under an alias is still resolved (section 3.3): `chain as c` then `c()` is an empty chain and fires HC007.

input.source:
from honest_type import chain as c
report = c()

cases.description: A composed type whose requires names a base type the vocabulary does not declare.

input.source:
from honest_type import vocabulary, composed
v = vocabulary({"digit": {"0", "1"}}, composed_types=[composed("pair", {"missing": "x"}, "digit")])

cases.description: Two Set types in one vocabulary sharing a value overlap, a decidable error.

input.source:
from honest_type import vocabulary
v = vocabulary({"a": {"x", "y"}, "b": {"y", "z"}})

cases.description: Two Set types with no shared value do not overlap.

input.source:
from honest_type import vocabulary
v = vocabulary({"a": {"x", "y"}, "b": {"z"}})

cases.description: A predicate recognizer may be a catch-all; honest-check cannot run it, so it reports info and defers to honest-test.

input.source:
from honest_type import vocabulary
v = vocabulary({"anything": lambda s: True})

cases.description: A transition table names a from-state that is not in the states vocabulary.

input.source:
from honest_type import state_machine
m = state_machine(["idle"], ["go"], {("running", "go"): "idle"}, "idle")

cases.description: A transition table names an event that is not in the events vocabulary.

input.source:
from honest_type import state_machine
m = state_machine(["idle", "run"], ["go"], {("idle", "stop"): "run"}, "idle")

cases.description: The initial state is not in the states vocabulary.

input.source:
from honest_type import state_machine
m = state_machine(["idle"], ["go"], {}, "missing")

cases.description: A state machine whose states, events, transitions and initial all agree fires nothing.

input.source:
from honest_type import state_machine
m = state_machine(["idle", "run"], ["go", "stop"], {("idle", "go"): "run", ("run", "stop"): "idle"}, "idle")

cases.description: A bare class declaration is dishonest: a record is a TypedDict and behaviour is a function.
